comparison.objective: Open the covered clean-ice source and use a scoop to put clean ice into a bowl without contamination.
comparison.physical_skill: Source selection, lid manipulation, scooping, and contamination avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: At least one clean cube is delivered by the scoop after opening the clean bin, with no contamination; fish-source ice earns only partial credit.
comparison.reason: Tests hygienic source choice and scooping rather than precise impact, intentional metal fracture, insert retention, and exhaustive fragment containment.
